body:
## Goal
Add a minimum implementation that makes edited-comment command handling read as the generic routing model discussed on PR #440, rather than as a `/fix-pr`-specific edge case.

## Context
PR #440 currently allows edited PR comments to dispatch `/fix-pr` only when the edit newly adds that explicit command, suppresses repeated edited `/fix-pr`, and keeps edited `/review` blocked with a visible explanation. In the latest discussion, @lolipopshock agreed with the broader framing that this is a generic edited-comment command problem and requested: `@sepo-agent /implement add a minimum implementation`.

The intended mental model from the discussion is:

```text
new comment: route normally
edited comment: compute newly added explicit commands
edited /fix-pr newly added: allow
edited /review newly added: explain blocked
already-present command edited again: ignore
```

Do not remove the edited-event gate unless repeated command execution on ordinary comment edits is explicitly accepted. `/fix-pr` is the first route where edited-comment commands are supported; `/review` remains blocked by policy.

Reference: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/440

## Acceptance Criteria
- Edited-comment handling is expressed as generic newly-added explicit command detection, with `/fix-pr` and `/review` treated as route policy outcomes.
- New comments continue to route normally.
- Edited comments only make a command actionable when that explicit command was newly introduced by the edit.
- Newly added edited `/fix-pr` on PR comments is allowed.
- Newly added edited `/review` on PR comments is blocked with the existing visible explanation.
- Already-present commands edited again are ignored and do not re-trigger automation.
- Keep the implementation minimal and focused on readability/policy shape, with tests updated or added only where needed to cover the generic behavior.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/440
